job.title: Injection Moulding
job.description:
Our partner is seeking experienced Injection Moulding Engineers to join a pioneering project that demands precision, expertise, and a results-driven mindset. This is your chance to be part of a cutting-edge initiative in Dublin, working on a high-impact, fast-paced environment where your skills will directly influence market success.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the development and validation of injection moulding processes, ensuring timely delivery of product schedules.
  • Manage the IQ, OQ, PQ phases for up to 30 tools, maintaining strict adherence to project timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to lay out and execute injection moulding schedules aligned with market needs and compliance standards.
  • Take ownership of process implementation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to support the launch of new products.

Required Skills:

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in injection moulding and process engineering.
  • Proven track record in managing injection moulding processes, including validation phases (IQ, OQ, PQ).
  • Strong understanding of tooling validation, process optimization, and production scheduling.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to work under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with self-dose injection pen projects or medical device manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with industry-specific regulations and audit requirements.
  • Additional engineering or automation skills related to moulding processes.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred.
  • At least 10 years’ hands-on experience in high-volume injection moulding environments.

Other Requirements:

  • This role is primarily onsite in Dublin, with a possibility of remote work one day a week.
  • Contract duration of a minimum of 12 months, with flexibility for quicker start depending on experience.
  • Rate range: €100 - €115/hr, with options regarding expenses (including or excluding expenses details to be discussed).
  • Full IR35 determination to be provided post-spec capture.
